title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 133 (Buckley Bay)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Buckley Bay
133 That portion of M.U. 1-06 in the vicinity of Buckley Bay, Nelson Land District, within the following described boundaries: Commencing at the northwest corner of Section 2, Lot 1 (Base Flat) on the mean high water mark of Lot 1; thence due North to a point 450 metres offshore; thence in an easterly and southerly direction maintaining a distance of 450 metres from the mean high water mark of Lot 1 to a point 450 metres offshore from the southeast corner of Lot 1 which is also the northeast corner of Lot 44; thence in a southerly and westerly direction maintaining a distance of 450 metres offshore from the mean high water mark of Lot 44 to a point on the east shore of Vancouver Island; thence generally northerly along the mean high water mark on the east shore of Vancouver Island to the point of commencement. [en. B.C. Reg. 221/2005, s. 3 (e).]
